meta.title: Persona Modes
meta.description: Switch between Catgirl, Tsundere, Sharp-tongued, Mom, Workhorse, Whale Girl, Maid, Young Lady, Daughter and Ultraman Tiga tones from Settings. Choose low/medium/high intensity, edit the address, self-name and prompt, or add custom personas. Only the voice changes; facts and code stay accurate, and Off injects nothing.
